rule: A geometry-verified base state whose evidence explicitly represents a multi-year range may begin in January of the first represented year only when no territorial change is recorded on the same track in that first year. For the continuous russian-legal-border succession, predecessor/successor polity ids are treated as one continuity chain so a state cannot be back-projected across a border change merely because the polity label changed.
purpose: Prevent artificial January-November gaps caused solely by coarse archive range dating without back-projecting states across documented border changes, including state-name transitions such as Russian Tsardom to Russian Empire.
